description:
A Nikke from the Happy Zoo Squad, which is responsible for overseeing the Ark's animals.
Manages ferocious beasts like lions and tigers.
Shares a unique bond with a timid lion named Timi.

costumes.name: Zoo Keeper
costumes.description:
Leona costume.
Obtained from a Mission Pass.

lines.text: Oh, Timi, you're such a cutie!
I wish people wouldn't judge Timi based solely on his appearance. He's actually very kind.
I've always fed large animals, so whenever I touch small animals, I'm afraid that I'll end up hurting them.

Here's a kiss for you, Timi!
Would you like a kiss too, Zoo Keeper?
I like everything to be king-sized, whether it's animals or you, Zoo Keeper, hehe.
I want to be alone with you, so I won't bring Timi with me next time.
Are you tired of waiting, Timi? I'll play with you later.
Are you eager to see Zoo Keeper, Timi? Me too.
This place is nice and quiet. Perfect for walking Timi.
I don't suppose they've got any shops here that cater to big cats, do they?
I hope Timi's appearance doesn't scare anyone.
Hello there, my name is Leona, and this cute lion here is Timi.
You have hopes of me becoming better at my job, right? I'll try my best, I promise.
I feel like my body has become lighter. Thanks!
I'm more skilled now.
Wow, thanks! I'll put it to good use.
Timi seems to like it too, haha.
I'm not used to getting gifts all the time.
It would be nice if you could be there for me like Timi has.
What should I do? I'm growing more and more fond of you, Zoo Keeper. Timi might get jealous...
Oh boy... my heart is beating faster than the last time I saw a brown bear out in the wild.
Off I go, Timi.
Roar!
On my way.
You fools dare stand in the way of a lion?
Looks like we've got some naughty kids who need taking care of.
Let the training begin!
You're all worse than beasts.
Replenishing ammo.
Give me a second.
Can you keep an eye out for me?
I'm ready.
Who wants some treats? Come over here!
Bite at will!
Gotcha.
How was that? Am I doing good?
There are still so many.
Ouch!
*Whimper*
Ugh...!
Sorry, but I'm standing down.
Never tread on the lion's tail.
